reason: A mobile-access plugin for DeepSeek Harness that provides QR-based LAN or cloudflared public access, real-time interface synchronization, and bidirectional control through a local proxy.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供二维码访问、局域网或公网连接，以及适配手机端的实时界面同步与交互控制。
summaries.en: Provides QR-based LAN or public access to DeepSeek Harness with mobile-optimized, real-time interface synchronization and interaction.

capabilities: Provides LAN and public-network access to the DeepSeek Harness web interface
Creates QR codes and access URLs for mobile clients
Relays HTTP and WebSocket traffic through a local reverse proxy
Can launch and recover a cloudflared public tunnel
Supports bidirectional interaction with a DeepSeek Harness instance that may execute computer code
Stores access tokens and settings on the local filesystem
